name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: (6b) All OCTs except one have permanent populations whose inhabitants enjoy the full rights of citizenship of the Union by virtue of their nationality of the Member State to which the OCT is associated. The Union and the respective Member States should take concrete measures to ensure that their citizenship rights can be exercised, including through equal access to political participation, information, and representation within Union institutions, as well as removing barriers to the exercise of their voting rights.
